hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]])git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*--force'; then branch=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOQUEADO: git push --force (ou --force-with-lease) em main. Crie uma branch ou refaça o commit local."}}'; fi; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])firebase[[:space:]]+deploy([[:space:]]|$)'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); local_h=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); remote_h=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null); msgs=""; if [ "${dirty:-0}" != "0" ] && [ "${dirty:-0}" != "" ]; then msgs="TREE SUJO: $dirty arquivo(s) nao commitado(s). O build compila o WORKING TREE, nao o HEAD - esse deploy publica codigo que nao esta em commit nenhum."; fi; if [ -n "$local_h" ] && [ -n "$remote_h" ] && [ "$local_h" != "$remote_h" ]; then msgs="$msgs HEAD local difere de origin/main: faca git push antes do deploy."; fi; if [ -n "$msgs" ]; then jq -nc --arg m "$msgs" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$m}}'; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Pre-check deploy: tree sujo + sync com origin...

hooks.command: input=$(cat); should_log=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .tool_response.success == false then "yes" else "no" end'); if [ "$should_log" = "yes" ]; then mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs" && echo "$input" | jq -c '{ts: now, tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input, error: .tool_response}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs/tool-failures.jsonl"; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])firebase[[:space:]]+deploy([[:space:]]|$)'; then out=$(node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/smoke-prod.mjs" 2>&1); printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs '{systemMessage: ("🔎 Smoke pós-deploy:\n" + .)}'; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) && c=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && [ -n "$b" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"📍 Branch: %s | %s arquivo(s) não commitado(s)"}}' "$b" "$c"
